new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/date-time")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header(string("X-Issued-At"), NottableDateTimeString.after("now -1 hours"), string("plain")),
                        new Header(string("If-Modified-Since"), NottableDateTimeString.before("2026-10-21T00:00:00Z").withActualFormat("rfc1123")),
                        new Header("X-Plain", "before:2026-01-01")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie(string("seen"), NottableDateTimeString.equalToDateTime("now +1 days").withTruncateExpected("first day of month").withTruncateActual("startOfDay").withApplyTruncationLast(true).withNot(true)),
                        new Cookie("plain", "x")
                )
                .withQueryStringParameters(
                        new Parameter(string("from"), NottableDateTimeString.after("2026-01-01").withActualFormat("dd/MM/yyyy").withZone("Europe/London"))
                ),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withBody("dated")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/epoch")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header(string("X-Epoch"), NottableDateTimeString.equalToDateTime("2026-06-15T12:30:45Z").withActualFormat("epochMillis"), NottableDateTimeString.before("now PT1H").withTruncateActual("startOfHour").withZone("+02:00").withNot(true))
                )
                .withQueryStringParameters(
                        new Parameter(not("at"), NottableDateTimeString.after("Mon, 15 Jun 2026 12:00:00 GMT").withTruncateExpected("startOfDay"))
                ),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("epoch")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/json-path")
                .withBody(new JsonPathBody("$.issuedAt", NottableDateTimeString.after("now -1 days").withZone("UTC").withNot(true))),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("jp")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/xpath")
                .withBody(new XPathBody("/root/issuedAt", null, NottableDateTimeString.before("now +1 days").withActualFormat("yyyy-MM-dd"))),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("xp")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/xpath-ns")
                .withBody(new XPathBody("/a:root/a:issuedAt", java.util.Map.ofEntries(java.util.Map.entry("a", "urn:a")), NottableDateTimeString.equalToDateTime("2026-01-01"))),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        response()
                .withBody("xpn")
);
